title: Street intersection with multi-storey commercial buildings and pedestrians
objects_and_counts: People: at least 9 distinct people visible in the photographed scene — 6 pedestrians walking on the left sidewalk (some partially cropped), and 3 cyclists near the center of the image. Several people are partially obscured by other pedestrians or by bicycle handlebars.

Vehicles: at least 3 motor vehicles visible on the road (a dark van at right foreground, a black car near center, and another car further back) and 2 bicycles being ridden in the near foreground. Exact total vehicle count in the scene cannot be determined due to occlusion beyond the visible area.

Buildings and façades: multiple multi-storey commercial buildings visible across the middle of the image, including a tall building with a red 'JTB' sign near the top left of the main cluster and a building with a large yellow and red sign (kanji) on its façade near the center-right.

Street furniture and fixtures: at least two decorative black street lamp posts visible near the center of the image, multiple traffic poles with signs, a pedestrian railing along the right-side curb, and a freestanding green 'i' information column at far right foreground.
Signs and storefronts: multiple storefronts and signage panels are visible on the ground and lower floors of the buildings (see visible_text for exact labels).
spatial_relations: The cluster of multi-storey buildings occupies the central and left-central portion of the image; the tallest building with the red 'JTB' sign is toward the left of this cluster.
A building with a large yellow-and-red kanji sign ('薬') is located center-right on the block and is directly above a ground-floor storefront with glass windows.
Decorative black lamp posts are located in the foreground center-right, in front of the building with the yellow/red sign; one lamp post partially obscures part of that sign.
Pedestrians and cyclists are on the left-side sidewalk and in the foreground, moving toward the center of the image; bicycles are between the sidewalk and the vehicular lane.
A green information column with a white 'i' symbol stands in the right foreground near the curb; the roadway and vehicles lie immediately to its left.
colours_and_materials: Sky: clear bright blue sky occupying the upper right portion of the image.

Buildings: mostly light-coloured façades (beige, off-white, and pale pink) with dark glass panels on at least one building; a black-glass vertical façade is visible on the left side of the central building cluster.

Signage: the large kanji sign near center-right is bright yellow with red characters; the 'JTB' sign is red with white letters; the 'PROMISE' sign is blue with white letters; the 'COTE D'AZUR' sign is blue with white text and a yellow crescent.
Street furniture: lamp posts are black metal; pedestrian paving in the foreground is light grey tile.
uncertainties: Exact room name or room number is not visible; therefore location is unknown from image.

Several small signs and storefront texts are partially obscured, at angles, or too small to fully read; examples include partial 'PROM' visible on a storefront and smaller window stickers that are unreadable.
Some visible text items may repeat (for example 'JTB' appears on more than one panel) or be partially duplicated in different positions; counts do not aggregate repeated views of the same sign.

The transcription list includes prominent legible text; other smaller or angled text on windows and banners was not readable at image resolution and is omitted or replaced by [unreadable] where necessary.
Vehicle and person counts are minimum visible totals; occlusion and cropping prevent a definitive room- or block-wide inventory.
